comment: Figure 3: HCMV TRATKMQVI is the explicit negative-control peptide for this expressed receptor. Parent gene is not specified. No structural evidence is assigned to the control.

Primary Figure3 functional CD69 assay, source variant P5A: negative. The source marks position6 as bold-italic C and explicitly identifies aminobutyric acid substituted for cysteine. [ABA] preserves that chemical identity; it is not a canonical amino-acid peptide token and this file is excluded from the positive build. Source WT and P4A responses are above the negative control; P5A and P8A responses are indistinguishable from the negative control. Same explicitly expressed Vα3S1/Vβ13S1 pair and HLA-C*06:02 targets as the canonical C2CD assay. No structural result is assigned to these functional observations.
